description: A product family (VM Plans, AI Tokens, SaaS Storage, Remote Storage). Behavioral and self-describing: it declares the resource types a member plan may include, its sub-category axis, and which configurator builder authors it. Adding a family is a new document, not a schema change (ADR 0007).

fields.label: Configurator Builder
fields.description: Which Plan Configurator builder authors this category. VM Rungs = the vCPU/memory/disk/transfer ladder; Simple = name + included quantity + rate.

fields.label: Provision Target
fields.description: What a member plan provisions, if anything. 'Server' = offered in the create-server flow. Blank = not directly provisionable here (e.g. metered AI Tokens, storage subscriptions). New provisioning surfaces add their own option.

fields.label: Sub-Category Label
fields.description: What a sub-category means for this family (e.g. 'Optimization profile', 'Storage purpose'). Blank = this family has no sub-category axis; plans attach directly to the category.

fields.label: Billing Type
fields.description: Fixed = a flat rate per billing cycle (a bundle). Metered = per-unit usage billing; a member plan with a single resource is a metering target resolved by its resource type (ADR 0008).

fields.label: Billing Interval
fields.description: The metering cadence for a Metered family. Leave blank for Fixed families.

fields.label: Pricing Mode
fields.description: For a Metered family: Grandfathered bills the rate locked at provision (like bundles); Live reads the current Catalog Rate each period with no allowance, for depreciating storage (ADR 0002). Leave blank for Fixed families.

fields.label: Allowed Resource Types
fields.description: A member plan's composition may only use these resource types. Blank = unconstrained.

name: Plan Category
